messages:
sam_sdr: Quick heads-up
New POC request from GreenLedger. They want an explicit statement: "no telemetry, backups, or logs leave the EU for the POC window". Asked for subprocessors list + cost delta.

nora_presales: Short: hosted = EU-affinity (soft). For contractual "no-cross-border" need Dedicated or Private. We can switch telemetry vendors to EU-only endpoints for the POC but backups/DR and autoscale are tricky.

vijay_security: We can produce subprocessors export and a security attestation. If they demand a contract clause, legal will require BYOK or key custody terms and audit rights. That will move this to an enterprise sale.

lena_ops: Operational note: we can provision a pinned tenant in eu-west-1 and disable cross-region backups for the POC window. However, if they run heavy long-context tests without reserved headroom, autoscale may trigger fallback. Recommend reserving capacity for the POC or using Dedicated.

sam_sdr: Can infra produce subprocessors list quickly and a one-line scoping sentence I can send the customer? Also need a ballpark uplift for Dedicated for ~12 seats, 21-day POC.

infra_bot: export generated: s3://exports/greenledger/poc_subprocessors_2026-03-24.csv (includes vendor contacts and SCC references).

nora_presales: One-line scoping for customer: "During the POC we will process and store customer data in EU regions. Hosted accounts will use EU affinity; backups and third-party telemetry may be processed outside the EU unless Dedicated or Private deployment is purchased. We will provide a subprocessors list and vendor attestations for the POC period."

vijay_security: Add note for customer: "If GreenLedger requires contractually-binding EU-only processing, we will require Dedicated/Private deployment and BYOK for key custody; legal to draft SLA and audit clause."

lena_ops: Ballpark: Dedicated uplift ~25-35% over hosted for a short 21-day reservation depending on GPU sizing; include minimum monthly commit.

sam_sdr: Great. I'll attach the infra export and send scoping line + ask if they accept hosted-affinity or need strict contractual guarantee. Will report back.
